---
title: "Shark Attacks"
---

The Global Shark Attack File is a public record of reported shark incidents
around the world. Although these events receive considerable attention, the
risk of a shark attack is relatively low.

Explore the **Map** to see where reported attacks have occurred and the
**Trends** page to follow attacks over time and compare outcomes across common
activities. The visualizations use records from the Global Shark Attack File;
they describe reported incidents, not the likelihood of an encounter.
